summary: Cut the delivery domain (mailbox reads, leases, wakes and changes, message subscriptions and point qualification, agent messages, conversation reads, glasses, directive notes, the assistant write gate, and the custom-subject and projection-divergence reads they use) out of st3-store at function level into the new st3-delivery crate; its Store methods are extension traits that st3-daemon re-exports, and every module keeps its old path.
